topic: Authored one-tile field presentation and ultrawide composition
currentUserGoal: Replace the ecosystem prototype's debug-harness appearance with a game-quality opening scene that preserves the scalable field renderer and looks intentional on ultrawide, desktop, and phone screens.
workCompleted: Constrained desktop content to a centered 1680-pixel stage so ultrawide screens no longer stretch the HUD and field across acres of empty space.
Recomposed the pre-sprinkler opening into three clear regions: a Field Heir identity panel, the central Living Field, and a live Care Balance panel opposing production against Scourge demand.
Restored the existing player portrait as a prominent opening-scene signal without bringing back the removed Sensi advisor panel.
Turned the single tile into an authored root plot with layered soil and brass framing, stage-colored trim, corner fittings, aura rings, a stage plaque, and a substantially larger touch target.
Added a fixed pool of 18 orbiting dew, pollen, grass, and spore motes plus subtle portrait, Scourge, helper, and tile motion without introducing per-frame field-sized work.
Forced nearest-neighbor filtering for pixel-art field, helper, character, and effect assets while retaining antialiased UI text.
Added readable manual-touch yield, permanent touch reach, Care coverage, production deficit, HP, and field-stage readouts to the opening side panels.
Removed one-tile zoom controls and locked one-tile panning/zooming so the authored focal composition cannot be accidentally dragged apart.
Kept zoom controls available after field expansion and relayouted immediately when Cultivation or debug field changes alter field size.
Hidden the developer control panel on the normal playtest URL while preserving every semantic automation action; the visible panel now requires the explicit debugPanel query parameter.
Fixed the missing grass-fleck effect asset path discovered during browser verification.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 103 Vitest tests across 13 files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Browser visual verification passed at the user's 2048x738 ultrawide viewport, the required 1280x720 desktop viewport, and the required 390x844 phone viewport.
The normal ?redesign&ecosystemPrototype&playtest URL showed no visible developer panel and produced no browser errors or warnings in a fresh tab.
The explicit debugPanel URL displayed the developer panel and retained exactly one semantic debug currency action.
A semantic coordinate touch and a real canvas-center click each increased RT by 0.92 and restored Ancient HP, confirming both automation and player input paths after the layout change.
Opening Options paused simulation and correctly reported optionsOpen through the redesign DOM snapshot.
The phone page remained exactly 390 pixels wide by 844 pixels high with no document overflow.

release.status: Local isolated prototype checkpoint; not merged into master or promoted to production.

currentGitStatus: Expected after checkpoint commit: clean codex/ecosystem-factory-prototype branch.
The local Vite server is running on http://127.0.0.1:5173.
The browser test field was left paused in Options after input verification; this does not affect source or saves on another browser profile.
knownIssues: The mature production economy and later field tiers still need hands-on balance testing; this slice deliberately focused on the weak opening presentation.
The pre-sprinkler side panels intentionally disappear below 1100 pixels and on phone, where the compact header carries the Care-versus-Scourge state.
Helper actions still reuse the existing small effect assets and synthesized SFX; unique late-tier audiovisual identities remain later polish work.
The Care Balance meter is intentionally severe at zero production; the first-sprinkler unlock flow still needs a full player pacing pass.
nextRecommendedSteps: Hands-on test the complete fresh Run 1 into the first Tiny Sprinkler Memory and judge whether the stronger visual opening also makes the survival pressure legible.
Polish the first helper unlock and purchase as the next visual payoff, including the transition from Field Heir side panels to the Living Ledger.
Tune first-run Scourge and manual Care only from observed play timing, not from screenshots.
After the first two runs feel good, give the Ecosystem Works and Memory Nursery the same authored visual hierarchy as the field opening.
doNotRevert: Keep the scalable field simulation, compact tile state, and LOD renderer underneath this authored one-tile presentation.
Keep the normal playtest URL free of visible developer controls; use debugPanel only when a human needs the debug overlay.
Keep the player portrait in the player identity slot and do not restore Sensi as the player avatar or advisor panel.
Keep pixel-art assets on nearest-neighbor filtering while leaving UI text antialiased.
Keep the opening scene bounded on ultrawide displays and do not return to a full-width empty field card.
Do not use the legacy 1200-tile harness as redesign evidence.
